question: A retail company has a generative AI (GenAI) product recommendation application that uses Amazon Bedrock. The application suggests products to customers based on browsing history and demographics. The company needs to implement fairness evaluation across multiple demographic groups to detect and measure bias in recommendations between two prompt approaches. The company wants to collect and monitor fairness metrics in real time. The company must receive an alert if the fairness metrics show a discrepancy of more than 15% between demographic groups. The company must receive weekly reports that compare the performance of the two prompt approaches. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST custom development effort?

options.A: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard to display default metrics from Amazon Bedrock API calls. Create custom metrics based on model outputs. Set up Amazon EventBridge rules to invoke AWS lambda functions that perform post- processing analysis on model responses and publish custom fairness metrics.
options.B: Create the two prompt variants in Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management. Use Amazon Bedrock Flows to deploy the prompt variants with defined traffic allocation. Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails that have content filters to monitor demographic fairness. Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms on the GuardrailContentSource dimension that use InvocationsIntervened metrics to detect recommendation discrepancy threshold violations.
options.C: Set up Amazon SageMaker Clarify to analyze model outputs. Publish fairness metrics to Amazon CloudWatch. Create CloudWatch composite alarms that combine SageMaker Clarify bias metrics with Amazon Bedrock latency metrics to provide a comprehensive fairness evaluation dashboard.
options.D: Create an Amazon Bedrock model evaluation job to compare fairness between the two prompt variants. Enable model invocation logging in Amazon CloudWatch. Set up CloudWatch alarms for InvocationsIntervened metrics with a dimension for each demographic group.

explanations.A: 选项 A 为什么可能正确: 可以通过 Lambda 对模型响应做后处理，自己定义公平性指标并发布到 CloudWatch，再用告警实现15%阈值提 醒; 也能做两种Prompt方案对比。 为什么不满足“最少自定义开发”: 公平性评估需要: 分群 (demographic group) 识别、指标定义 (如差异率、均等机会等) 、统计检验、窗口聚合、A/B (两种 prompt) 归因等，全部需要自研。 自定义指标+事件驱动分析管道复杂，维护成本高。 结论: 可实现，但自定义开发量明显最大，不符合"LEAST custom development effort’
explanations.B: 选项 B 为什么可能看起来正确: Prompt Management + Flows 能做两种prompt变体与流量分配 (类似A/B) ; CloudWatch 告警也能做阔 值提醒。 为什么错误/不合适: Guardrails 的 content filters主要用于安全策略 (如暴力、仇恨、色情、PII等) 过滤与拦截，不是用于计算"不同人口统计群体间推 荐公平性差异"的统计指标。 InvocationsIntervened通常指被护栏拦截/干预的调用数量; 与“推荐偏差超过15%"没有直接对应关系。 无法自然表达“跨人口统计群体差异15%"“这种公平性度量与对比报表。 结论: 把“公平性评估"错误地映射为"护栏拦截指标"，不满足题意。
explanations.C: 选项 C 为什么正确: SageMaker Clarify是AWS中专门用于偏差/公平性分析与指标产出的托管能力，适合“跨多个群体检测并量化差异"。 将公平性指标发布到 CloudWatch后，可用 CloudWatch Alarms 做超过15%的阈值告警，并在仪表盘进行 (Of) 实时监控。 每周报告: Clarify 的分析输出天然适合形成报告/对比结果; 配合按周期运行分析任务 (例如每周) SCH prompts ss’ AXLE 报告 (按prompt标签/维度拆分) 。 相较于自建Lambda后处理，Clarify 显著减少自定义公平性算法与统计汇总的开发工作。 需要注意的点 (不影响本题最优选择) : Clarify 更常见是批处理/定期作业形态; 若题目"real time'严格到秒级，任何方案都需要自建流式计算。但在给定选项里，C 最接 近“近实时监控 + BD BOR". 选项里提到“复合告警将 Clarify 偏差指标与 Bedrock 延迟指标组合"，延迟指标对“公平性"本身不是必须，但不影响其满足公平性监 控与报表的主要诉求。 结论: 最贴合公平性评估托管能力，并能与 CloudWatch 告警/报表结合，且自定义开发最少。
explanations.D: 选项 D  ”为什么可能看起来正确: Bedrock model evaluation job 可用于对比不同prompt变体的效果。 为什么错误/不合适: 模型评估作业更偏离线评测 (例如基准集评估) ，不天然满足"实时监控与告警"。 同样把 InvocationsIntervened当作公平性指标来源不合理; 该指标与人口统计群体之间推荐差异15%"“没有直接映射。 “为每个人口统计群体设置一个维度"的描述也不符合 InvocationsIntervened 的典型维度设计与用途。 Sit: 离线评估+错误指标来源，无法满足题意的实时公平性监控与告警。

question: A finance company is developing an AI assistant to help clients plan investments and manage their portfolios. The company identifies several high-risk conversation patterns such as requests for specific stock recommendations or guaranteed returns. High-risk conversation patterns could lead to regulatory violations if the company cannot implement appropriate controls. The company must ensure that the AI assistant does not provide inappropriate financial advice, generate content about competitors, or make claims that are not factually grounded in the company's approved financial guidance. The company wants to use Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to implement a solution. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Add the high-risk conversation patterns to a denied topics guardrail.
options.B: Configure a content filter guardrail to filter prompts that contain the high-risk conversation patterns.
options.C: Configure a content filter guardrail to filter prompts that contain competitor names.
options.D: Add the names of competitors as custom word filters. Set the input and output actions to block.
options.E: Set a low grounding score threshold.
options.F: Set a high grounding score threshold.

explanations.A: A. Add the high-risk conversation patterns to a denied topics guardrail. 正确。 Denied topics 适合把“请求具体荐股/保证收益/个性化投资建议“等作为高风险主题进行阻断或安全改写，满足"不能提供不恰当金融 建议/避免监管违规"的核心诉求。
explanations.B: B. Configure a content filter guardrail to filter prompts that contain the high-risk conversation patterns. 错误 (不匹配/不推荐) 。 Content filters 通常针对通用安全类别 (如暴力、仇恨、性内容等) 进行过滤;题干的"高风险对话模式 (具体荐股、保证收益) “属 于业务合规意图，更应使用 denied topics (主题级) 或自定义策略，而不是依赖内容过滤来"匹配模式"。
explanations.C: C. Configure a content filter guardrail to filter prompts that contain competitor names. 错误。 竞争对手名称属于“特定词表/实体"拦截需求，更适合用 custom word filters 精准控制; content filters 并非为"命名实体黑名单'设 计。
explanations.D: D. Add the names of competitors as custom word filters. Set the input and output actions to block. 正确。 Custom word filters 可将竞争对手名称加入黑名单，并对输入与输出都设置 block，既防止用户诱导提及竞争对手，也防止模型自 行生成相关内容。
explanations.E: E. Set a low grounding score threshold. 错误。 低 grounding 阈值意味着"更宽松地允许低依据内容通过“，会增加模型产生不具事实依据的宣称 (hallucination) 风险，与'不得做 未经公司批准目无事实依据的声明"相违彰。
explanations.F: F. Set a high grounding score threshold. 正确。 高 grounding 阈值会要求回答与提供的权威上下文/公司批准指引保持更强一致性，降低无依据编造与越权承诺 (例如"保证收益"”) 的概率，更符合金融合规场景。

question: A company has deployed an AI assistant as a React application that uses AWS Amplify, an AWS AppSync GraphQL API, and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases. The application uses the GraphQL API to call the Amazon Bedrock RetrieveAndGenerate API for knowledge base interactions. The company configures an AWS Lambda resolver to use the RequestResponse invocation type. Application users report frequent timeouts and slow response times. Users report these problems more frequently for complex questions that require longer processing. The company needs a solution to fix these performance issues and enhance the user experience. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Amplify AI Kit to implement streaming responses from the GraphQL API and to optimize client-side rendering.
options.B: Increase the timeout value of the Lambda resolver. Implement retry logic with exponential backoff.
options.C: Update the application to send an API request to an Amazon SQS queue. Update the AWS AppSync resolver to poll and process the queue.
options.D: Change the RetrieveAndGenerate API to the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API. Update the application to use an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to support the streaming response.

explanations.A: A. Use AWS Amplify AI Kit to implement streaming responses from the GraphQL API and to optimize client-side rendering. 为什么可能正确: 核心命中“增强用户体验"的关键: 流式返回让用户更快看到输出，显著降低体感延迟。 在生成耗时不可避免时 (复杂问题) ，流式输出通常比“等全部生成完再一次性返回"更能缓解超时与等待问题。 Amplify AI Kit 的定位就是简化前端对生成式 AI 的集成 (包括流式处理与Ul更新模式) ，与题干"React + Amplify’ SEA. 潜在注意点: 前提是 GraphQLVAPI 层能支持把上游的增量结果传到客户端 (或通过订阅/事件方式呈现) 。但从考试语境与选项表述看，A 明确 指向“用现成工具把 streaming 做起来"。 结论: 正确性很高。
explanations.B: B. Increase the timeout value of the Lambda resolver. Implement retry logic with exponential backoff. 为什么错误 : AppSync Resolver (调用 Lambda) 存在服务侧超时上限: 即使提高 Lambda 自身 timeout，也可能仍受 AppSync 同步调用超时 限制，无法根治。 重试 + 指数退避通常用于“暂时性失败/限流“，但这里是“计算/生成本来就慢“。重试会让用户等待更久、成本更高、并发更差。 不解决"增强用户体验”要求: 用户仍然在等待一个同步大响应，体感延迟与超时概率依旧。 结论: 不满足需求。
explanations.C: C. Update the application to send an API request to an Amazon SQS queue. Update the AWS AppSync resolver to poll and process the queue. 为什么错误: SQS 适合异步解耦，但选项描述为"AppSsync resolver 轮询并处理队列'不符合常规模式: Resolver 应该快速完成请求，不适合做轮 询等待。 即使改成异步处理，也需要额外机制把结果推回客户端 (如订阅、Websocket、通知等) 。该选项没有给出完整闭环，且“轮询"会 进一步恶化延迟与成本。 无法直接实现*流式响应"的体验提升。 Sit: 方案不合理上且不满足需求。
explanations.D: D. Change the RetrieveAndGenerate API to the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API. Update the application to use an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to support the streaming response. 为什么大概率错误 (或不如A) : 题干明确使用的是Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases + RetrieveAndGenerate 做 RAG。改成 InvokeModelWithResponseStream 是直接调用基础模型的流式接口，可能丢失 Knowledge Base 检索增强能力 (除非自行实现 检索与拼接提示词) ，与现有架构目标不一致。 引入 API Gateway WebSocket 会绕开既有 AppSync/Amplify 的调用路径，改造面更大。 A Foxy + WebsSocket'"可改善体验，但它没有体现“继续使用 KB 的 RetrieveAndGenerate 进行知识库交互"的连续性;从题意看应 优先在现有 GraphQL 架构内优化。 结论: 可能能做出流式体验，但与题干的 KB 交互路径不匹配、改造过大，且不如 A 贴合题意。

question: An ecommerce company operates a global product recommendation system that needs to switch between multiple foundation models (FM) in Amazon Bedrock based on regulations, cost optimization, and performance requirements. The company must apply custom controls based on proprietary business logic, including dynamic cost thresholds, AWS Region-specific compliance rules, and real-time A/B testing across multiple FMs. The system must be able to switch between FMs without deploying new code. The system must route user requests based on complex rules including user tier, transaction value, regulatory zone, and real-time cost metrics that change hourly and require immediate propagation across thousands of concurrent requests. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy an AWS Lambda function that uses environment variables to store routing rules and Amazon Bedrock FM IDs. Use the Lambda console to update the environment variables when business requirements change. Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to read request parameters to make routing decisions.
options.B: Deploy Amazon API Gateway REST API request transformation templates to implement routing logic based on request attributes. Store Amazon Bedrock FM endpoints as REST API stage variables. Update the variables when the system switches between models.
options.C: Configure an AWS Lambda function to fetch routing configurations from the AWS AppConfig Agent for each user request. Run business logic in the Lambda function to select the appropriate FM for each request. Expose the FM through a single Amazon API Gateway REST API endpoint.
options.D: Use AWS Lambda authorizers for an Amazon API Gateway REST API to evaluate routing rules that are stored in AWS AppConfig. Return authorization contexts based on business logic. Route requests to model-specific Lambda functions for each Amazon Bedrock FM.

explanations.A: 优点：实现简单；Lambda可执行复杂业务逻辑。问题1：环境变量更新不适合繁琐、即时、复杂配置：环境变量更新需要更新函数配置，存在传播与冷/热执行环境更新时机问题；在高并发与大量并行执行环境下，不保证'立即对所有并发请求生效'。问题2：可维护性与表达能力差：复杂路由规则（监管区域、动态成本阈值、A/B实验）用环境变量表达困难，且容易出错。问题3：操作与审计治理不足：相比AppConfig，缺少受控发布、分批发布、快速回滚、验证器（validators）等能力。结论：不满足'小时级变化且立即传播、复杂规则、无需发版'的可靠需求。
explanations.B: 优点：API Gateway阶段变量可在不改后端代码时调整一些参数；模板可做简单转换。问题1：API Gateway请求转换模板不适合作为复杂规则引擎：VTL/模板更适合做参数映射/转换，不适合实现复杂的合规判断、动态成本指标计算、实时A/B实验流策略等。问题2：阶段变量更新与治理能力有限：阶段变量并非为复杂动态配置与快速、安全发布而设计；对'立即传播到大量并发请求'的能力也不如AppConfig的专用机制清晰。问题3：Bedrock模型切换的表达不匹配：Bedrock通常通过Invoke Model/模型ID等方式调用，而不是'REST API阶段变量存endpoint'就能优雅解决复杂路由。结论：不满足复杂规则与强动态配置治理需求。
explanations.C: 做法：Lambda在每次请求时，通过AWS AppConfig Agent获取最新路由配置；Lambda执行专有业务逻辑选择合适FM；对外提供单一API入口。优点1：满足'无需重新部署代码即可切换FM'：路由策略、阈值、区域合规规则、实验开关都可以作为配置在AppConfig中变更。优点2：复杂规则可在Lambda中实现：可根据用户等级、交易额、监管区、实时成本指标等进行决策，并可实现更复杂的A/B测试逻辑。优点3：AppConfig适合A/B测试与快速传播：AppConfig天然支持Feature flags/动态配置、受控发布、回滚、审计；Agent/Extension提供本地缓存与快速更新机制，适合'小时级变化且需立即生效'的场景（避免每次都打控制面）。注意点（不影响其为最优）：在实现中通常会使用AWS AppConfig Lambda Extension来缓存与获取配置，而不是让Lambda去访问'Agent'本身（Agent更常见于EC2/ECS侧车）；但题干表达的意图是'使用AppConfig的运行时配置获取能力'。结论：满足题目所有关键要求，是最贴合的方案。
explanations.D: 思路：用Lambda Authorizer读取AppConfig规则并返回上下文，然后把请求路由到不同'模型专用Lambda'。问题1：API Gateway REST API不擅长基于Authorizer上下文做动态集成路由：Authorizer主要用于鉴权与注入上下文，REST API的方法集成（Integration）通常是预先固定的；要在运行时按复杂规则把同一个method动态切到不同后端集成并不自然。问题2：把路由由决策放在Authorizer语义不合理：Authorizer应聚焦认证/授权；把业务路由塞进去会增加延迟、复杂度与维护成本。问题3：并发与成本：每个请求都触发Authorizer（且可能再触发后端Lambda）会引入额外延迟与成本；并且仍未清晰解决'即时传播到所有并发请求'的端到端路径。结论：方案表达上可'想象'实现，但与API Gateway REST API能力边界不匹配，整体不如C稳妥。

question: A company is developing an internal generative AI (GenAI) assistant that uses Amazon Bedrock to summarize corporate documents for multiple business units. The GenAI assistant must generate responses in a consistent format that includes a document summary, classification of business risks, and terms that are flagged for review. The GenAI assistant must adapt the tone of responses for each user's business unit, such as legal, human resources, or finance. The GenAI assistant must block hate speech, inappropriate topics, and sensitive information such as personal health information. The company needs a solution to centrally manage prompt variants across business units and teams. The company wants to minimize ongoing orchestration efforts and maintenance for post-processing logic. The company also wants to have the ability to adjust content moderation criteria for the GenAI assistant over time. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST maintenance overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to configure reusable templates and business unit-specific prompt variants. Apply Amazon Bedrock guardrails that have category filters and sensitive term lists to block prohibited content.
options.B: Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to define base templates. Enforce business unit-specific tone by using system prompt variables. Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to apply audience-based threshold tuning. Manage the guardrails by using an internal administration API.
options.C: Use Amazon Bedrock with business unit-based instruction injection in API calls. Store response formatting rules in Amazon DynamoDB. Use AWS Step functions to validate responses. Use Amazon Comprehend to apply content filters after the GenAI assistant generates responses.
options.D: Use Amazon Bedrock with custom prompt templates that are stored in Amazon DynamoDB. Create one AWS Lambda function to select business unit-specific prompts. Create a second Lambda function to call Amazon Comprehend to filter prohibited content from responses.

explanations.A: A. Prompt Management + Guardrails (类别过滤 + 敏感词列表) 为什么正确: 集中管理提示词变体: Prompt Management 原生支持可复用模板与变体，符合"centrally manage prompt variants across business units and teams”, 减少后处理与编排: Guardrails 在模型生成时/调用时执行策略控制，减少额外的 Lambda/Step Functions/Comprehend 后处理链 路。 可随时间调整审核标准: Guardrails 的策略 (类别过滤、敏感词/敏感信息配置等) 可迭代更新，满足"adjust content moderation criteria over time”, 覆盖题目安全要求: 可用于拦截 hate speech, inappropriate topics，并通过敏感信息/敏感词机制降低泄露 PHI 等敏感内容风险。 一致格式 + 业务语气: 通过模板固定输出结构 (summary/risk classification/flagged terms) ，通过变体为 legayHR/finance 提供不 同 tone。 可能的边界点: 严格的结构化输出 (例如强制 ISON schema) 在现实中可能还会搭配额外校验; 但在本题选项中，A 已是最接近“最小维护”的托管 组合。
explanations.B: B. Prompt Management + system prompt variables + Guardrails “audience-based threshold tuning” + 内部管理API 为什么不如 A_(偏错误/不优) : 引入“内部管理 API增加维护成本: 题目强调 LEAST maintenance overhead，而自建管理 API 明显增加长期维护与治理复杂度。 “audience-based threshold tuning"“表述可疑: Guardrails 具备类别过滤强度等配置能力，但'“按受众阈值调优”并非该服务常见的 标准能力表述; 该选项更像是混入不必要/不明确的自定义管理概念。 即便可实现，也不如 A 简洁: A 已满足集中模板与可演进审核策略，无需额外 API 层。 结论: 即使部分可行，也不满足"最小维护开销"的最优解特征。
explanations.C: C. API 注入指令 + DynamoDB 存格式规则 + Step Functions 校验 + Comprehend 后置过滤 为什么错误 : 维护开销大: Step Functions 编排、规则存储与校验逻辑、Comprehend 后处理过滤都需要持续维护与调参。 后置过滤不如前置/内置护栏: 先生成再过滤，可能出现泄露风险 (例如日志、下游缓存、失败重试等路径) ，且处理复杂。 不符合“minimize ongoing orchestration efforts”: 这是典型"自建工作流 + 自建后处理"。
explanations.D: D. DynamoDB 存提示词模板 + Lambda 选提示词 + Lambda if] Comprehend Wiz 为什么错误 : 提示词治理不如 Prompt Management: 自建 DynamoDB 存模板缺少原生的集中治理体验 (版本、复用、变体管理等需要自建规 范) 。 仍是后处理过滤: 用 Comprehend 过滤属于额外链路与持续维护 (模型选择、闪值、误杀/漏检处理) 。 Lambda 链路增加维护: 两个 Lambda 的选择与过滤逻辑都要长期维护与监控。  ”4

question: A financial services company is building a customer support application that retrieves relevant financial regulation documents from a database based on semantic similarities to user queries. The application must integrate with Amazon Bedrock to generate responses. The application must be able to search documents that are in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. The application must filter documents by metadata such as publication date, regulatory agency, and document type. The database stores approximately 10 million document embeddings. To minimize operational overhead, the company wants a solution that minimizes management and maintenance effort. The application must provide low-latency responses for real-time customer interactions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon OpenSearch Serverless to provide vector search capabilities and metadata filtering. Connect to Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases to enable Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities that use an Anthropic Claude foundation model (FM).
options.B: Deploy an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database with the pgvector extension. Define tables to store embeddings and metadata. Use SQL queries to perform similarity searches. Send retrieved documents to Amazon Bedrock to generate responses.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 Vectors to configure a vector index and non-filterable metadata fields. Integrate S3 Vectors with Amazon Bedrock to enable Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities.
options.D: Set up an Amazon Neptune Analytics graph database. Configure a vector index that has appropriate dimensionality to store document embeddings. Use Amazon Bedrock to perform graph-based retrieval and to generate responses.

explanations.A: A. OpenSearch Serverless + Bedrock Knowledge Bases + Claude 为什么正确: 向量检索能力成熟: OpenSearch (含 serverless) 支持向量/近似最近邻检索，适合大规模embeddings。 支持元数据过滤: 可将 publication date、agency、document type 等作为字段进行过滤/组合查询 (典型为向量检索 + filter) 。 低运维: Serverless 形态减少集群容量规划、节点维护等运维负担，符合"minimize management and maintenance effort". 低延迟: 面向实时检索场景优化，相比把向量塞进通用关系库通常更容易获得稳定检索延迟。 与 Bedrock Knowledge Bases 集成: Knowledge Bases 是 Bedrock 原生 RAG 方案之一，可直接对接支持的向量存储 (包括 OpenSearch) ，降低应用侧拼装成本。 多语言: 多语言检索主要由 embedding 模型决定; Opensearch 负责存储向量与过滤，语言不是阻碍。 潜在注意点 (不影响本题结论) : 真正的多语言语义效果取决于你选用的多语言 embedding 模型 (如支持 ES/PT/EN BY embeddings) 。 Claude 用于生成回答本身合理; 检索质量仍取决于embedding 与索引配置。
explanations.B: B. Aurora PostgreSQL + pgvector + SQL 相似度检索 + Bedrock 生成 为什么不如 A (更可能错误) : 运维与调优成本更高: 为 1000 万向量做低延迟相似度检索，需要索引策略、参数调优、扩容、VACUUMV/ANALYZE、连接与负载管 IBS, BASLE Serverless 搜索服务更费精力。 规模与延迟风险: pgvector 可用，但在超大规模、强并发、低延迟实时检索场景下，常需要更谨慎的容量规划与优化; 不符合“尽 量低运维“。 元数据过滤可做: SQL 天然支持过滤，这点满足; 但综合权衡 (低运维+低延迟+10M) 不如 A. 与 Bedrock 的集成: 可以自行拼装 RAG，但没有"Bedrock Knowledge Bases + 托管向量存储"那种更省事的路径。 结论: 技术上可实现，但与题目"最小运维、实时低延迟、大规模“综合要求不匹配，因此不是最佳答案。
explanations.C: C. Amazon S3 Vectors + 不可过滤的元数据字段 + 与 Bedrock 集成 为什么错误: 题目明确要求按元数据过滤 (publication date、agency、document type) 。 该选项写明是“non-filterable metadata fields (不可过滤元数据字段) “，直接违背硬性需求。 即使能做向量检索并与 Bedrock 集成，但缺少过滤能力会导致召回不受控、合规/范围限定难以实现。
explanations.D: D. Neptune Analytics 图数据库 + 向量索引 + Bedrock 图检索 + 生成 为什么错误/不合适: 问题类型是语义相似度检索 + 元数据过滤，并不需要图关系遍历/图分析。 Neptune Analytics 更偏图分析场景; 把它作为 1000 万文档向量检索的主存储/检索层通常不如专用向量检索服务直接，复杂度和成 本/运维面也可能更高。 元数据过滤与检索整合并非其最典型路径，且题目强调“minimize management effort*"和"low-latency“，更贴近专用托管向量检索方

question: A medical company is building a generative AI (GenAI) application that uses RAG to provide evidence-based medical information. The application uses Amazon OpenSearch Service to retrieve vector embeddings. Users report that searches frequently miss results that contain exact medical terms and acronyms and return too many semantically similar but irrelevant documents. The company needs to improve retrieval quality and maintain low end user latency, even as the document collection grows to millions of documents. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure hybrid search by combining vector similarity with keyword matching to improve semantic understanding and exact term and acronym matching.
options.B: Increase the dimensions of the vector embeddings from 384 to 1536. Use a post-processing AWS Lambda function to filter out irrelevant results after retrieval.
options.C: Replace OpenSearch Service with Amazon Kendra. Use query expansion to handle medical acronyms and terminology variants during pre-processing.
options.D: Implement a two-stage retrieval architecture in which initial vector search results are re-ranked by an ML model that is hosted on Amazon SageMaker AI.

explanations.A: 为什么正确：能显著改善缺词/精确术语命中中：BM25/keyword对精确token、术语、缩写更敏感。能减少'语义相近但无关文档'：通过融合策略（例如加权、must/should子句、minimum_should_match、filter等）让'既语义相关又包含关键术语'的文档排更靠前。低延迟、低运维：仍在OpenSearch内完成检索与融合，不引入额外在线推理服务。百万级文档可扩展：OpenSearch针对倒排索引引+向量索引都可水平扩展，混合检索是常见生产做法。
explanations.B: 为什么错误：增加向量维度（384→1536）不必然解决缩略词/精确术语遗漏召回问题；很多缩写本身在语义空间仍可能混淆，且精确匹配需要更适合关键词检索。更高维向量会带来更大索引、更多内存/计算，可能提高成本并影响响应延迟，尤其在百万级规模。Lambda后处理属于'检索后再过滤'，通常已经把无关结果取回来了，无法提升召回阶段对精确术语的命中，还会增加链路复杂度与延迟。运维开销更高：需要维护过滤逻辑、版本、监控，并处理超时/并发。
explanations.C: 为什么不优/倾向错误：Kendra更偏企业搜索与连接器生态，确实有语义能力与同义词/扩展，但本题是使用OpenSearch向量检索，直接替换属于重大架构迁移，不符合'LEAST operational overhead'。查询扩展能帮助缩略词，但在医学场景可能引发歧义扩展（缩写多义），若无强约束仍可能带来噪声。对'低延迟+百万级向量检索'而言，Kendra是否满足现有向量检索与融合需求取决于实现方式；相比之下，OpenSearch原地混合检索更直接。
explanations.D: 为什么不满足'最少运维开销'：重排序（rerank）能显著提升精度，尤其能减少语义相近但不相关的结果，这点是优势。但需要额外托管一个在线推理端点（SageMaker），涉及模型选择/训练或微调、部署、扩缩容、监控、成本，运维开销明显更高。该会增加一次在线推理调用，端到端延迟通常更高；满足'低延迟'需要更复杂的容量规划。并且它不比混合检索直接解决'精确术语/缩略词'问题；通常需要引入关键词信号或特征。

question: A company runs a generative AI (GenAI)-powered summarization application in an application AWS account that uses Amazon Bedrock. The application architecture includes an Amazon API Gateway REST API that forwards requests to AWS Lambda functions that are attached to private VPC subnets. The application summarizes sensitive customer records that the company stores in a governed data lake in a centralized data storage account. The company has enabled Amazon S3, Amazon Athena, and AWS Glue in the data storage account. The company must ensure that calls that the application makes to Amazon Bedrock use only private connectivity between the company's application VPC and Amazon Bedrock. The company's data lake must provide fine-grained column-level access across the company's AWS accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements? S3、Amazon Athena 和 AWS Glue。

options.A: In the application account, create interface VPC endpoints for Amazon Bedrock runtimes. Run Lambda functions in private subnets. Use IAM conditions on inference and data-plane policies to allow calls only to approved endpoints and roles. In the data storage account, use AWS Lake Formation LF-tag-based access control to create table and column-level cross-account grants.
options.B: Run Lambda functions in private subnets. Configure a NAT gateway to provide access to Amazon Bedrock and the data lake. Use S3 bucket policies and ACLs to manage permissions. Export AWS CloudTrail logs to Amazon S3 to perform weekly reviews.
options.C: Create a gateway endpoint only for Amazon S3 in the application account. Invoke Amazon Bedrock through public endpoints. Use database-level grants in AWS Lake Formation to manage data access. Stream AWS CloudTrail logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Do not set up metric filters or alarms.
options.D: Use VPC endpoints to provide access to Amazon Bedrock and Amazon S3 in the application account. Use only IAM path- based policies to manage data lake access. Send AWS CloudTrail logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Periodically create dashboards and allow public fallback for cross-Region reads to reduce setup time.

explanations.A: 接口型VPC端点用于Amazon Bedrock runtimes：符合。Bedrock的数据平面（Runtime）支持通过Interface VPC Endpoint/PrivateLink私网访问，满足'仅私有连接'。Lambda在私有子网：符合前提架构，也确保函数无需公网IP即可通过VPCE访问服务。用IAM条件限制只允许已批准的endpoints和roles：关键点正确。通过条件件键（常见如aws:SourceVpce）可强制请求必须来自指定VPCE，从而避免走公网Bedrock端点。Lake Formation LF-tag-based access control实现表/列级跨账号授权：符合。LF-Tag能规模化管理跨账号的表/列权限，满足'fine-grained column-level access across accounts'。结论：同时满足两项核心需求。
explanations.B: NAT Gateway访问Bedrock和数据湖：不符合'仅私有连接'。NAT出去本质上是访问公网服务端点（即使链路出站经NAT），不满足'只使用私有连接'。S3 bucket policies和ACL管权限：无法实现Lake Formation级别的治理与列级精细控制（ACL也不是数据湖治理首选）。导出CloudTrail周审：与题目核心要求无关，且不能替代私网与列级权限控制。结论：两项要求都不满足或不充分。
explanations.C: 只给S3建gateway endpoint：对访问S3私网有帮助，但题目要求的是Bedrock私网；此处明确说Bedrock通过公有端点调用，直接违背'仅私有连接'。Lake Formation数据库级授权：数据库级粒度太粗，不能保证列级精细权限。CloudTrail到CloudWatch logs且不做告警：与题目主线不相关，且不影响私网/列级权限。结论：不满足两项核心需求。
explanations.D: 使用VPC endpoints访问Bedrock和S3：方向对（Bedrock需要Interface VPCE，S3可用Gateway/Interface视场景），但后续条件使其整体不满足要求。仅使用IAM path-based policies管数据湖访问：无法实现Lake Formation的列级、跨账号治理（Athena/Glue/LF的治理体系并非靠'路径型IAM'就能完整满足）。允许public fallback for cross-Region reads：引入'公网回退'与题目'只用私有连接'理念冲突（至少对Bedrock私网要求是不允许回退公网的）。结论：数据湖列级跨账号治理不满足，且'公网回退'不符合私网强约束。

question: A media company must use Amazon Bedrock to implement a robust governance process for AI-generated content. The company needs to manage hundreds of prompt templates. Multiple teams use the templates across multiple AWS Regions to generate content. The solution must provide version control with approval workflows that include notifications for pending reviews. The solution must also provide detailed audit trails that document prompt activities and consistent prompt parameterization to enforce quality standards. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Bedrock Studio prompt templates. Use Amazon CloudWatch to create dashboards that display prompt usage metrics. Store the approval status of content in Amazon DynamoDB. Use AWS Lambda functions to enforce approvals.
options.B: Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to implement version control. Configure AWS CloudTrail for audit logging. Use IAM policies to control approval permissions. Create parameterized prompt templates by specifying variables.
options.C: Use AWS Step Functions to create an approval workflow. Store prompts as documents in Amazon S3. Use tags to implement version control. Use Amazon EventBridge to send notifications.
options.D: Deploy Amazon SageMaker Canvas with prompt templates that are stored in Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudFormation to implement version control. Use AWS Config to enforce approval policies.

explanations.A: 优点：CloudWatch可做指标看板（但偏'监控/指标'，不等于'审计追踪'）。DynamoDB + Lambda可以自建审批逻辑。问题：缺少版本控制与审批工作流的原生治理能力：Bedrock Studio prompt templates更偏交互式开发/管理界面能力描述，不等同于题目要求的'robust governance process''version control with approval workflows'高度匹配。审计追踪不完整：CloudWatch指标不是审计日志；题目要'detailed audit trails that document prompt activities'，更匹配CloudTrail（API/控制面审计）与/或应用层日志。参数化一致性未体现：没有说明如何统一变量、模板化参数，来'enforce quality standards'。跨Region、多团队共享治理也没有清晰方案（DynamoDB/Lambda可以做，但与Bedrock模板治理的整合不清晰且工程量大）。结论：不满足关键要求（版本控制、审计、参数化一致性、成熟审批流）。
explanations.B: 优点：版本控制：使用Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management直接实现提示模板的管理与版本化，契合'manage hundreds of prompt templates'。审计追踪：配置AWS CloudTrail，可记录对Bedrock相关资源的控制面操作（创建/更新/删除/发布/权限变更等），满足'detailed audit trails'（至少覆盖治理与变更轨迹）。权限/审批控制：用IAM policies控制谁可以审批、谁可以发布/更新版本等，符合'approval permissions'。参数化一致性：通过变量（variables）创建参数化模板，能强制团队按一致字段输入，支持质量标准。潜在不足/需要辨析点：题目要求'approval workflows that include notifications for pending reviews'。B只用IAM控权与版本控制，并未明确'工作流引擎'和'通知服务'（如EventBridge/SNS）。但在四个选项中，B是唯一把'Bedrock Prompt Management + CloudTrail + 参数化'完整对齐治理目标的；审批通知可被理解为Prompt Management/相关治理流程的一部分或可在实现中补充（题目是选择最满足需求的方案）。结论：在给定选项中，B与题面匹配度最高，整体满足治理、版本、审计、参数化与权限控制的核心要求。
explanations.C: 优点：审批工作流：Step Functions明确支持人工审批/等待状态等模式，能实现'approval workflow'。通知：EventBridge可触发SNS/ChatOps/邮件等，满足'notifications for pending reviews'。问题：版本控制不可靠：用S3 Tag做'版本控制'不是严谨的版本管理手段；S3的版本控制应使用bucket versioning或对象版本ID，而'tag'更适合分类检索，不适合审批发布链路的不可变版本治理。缺少Bedrock Prompt Management：题目强调'must use Amazon Bedrock'，C把prompts当文档放S3，自建流程，缺乏Bedrock原生提示模板治理能力（模板变量、共享、治理策略等）。审计追踪不完整：未提CloudTrail；即使Step Functions/S3有日志，也不等同于对Bedrock提示模板活动的审计闭环。参数化一致性没有体现：仅存文档不足以强制变量输入规范与质量标准。结论：工作流与通知强，但提示模板治理（版本、参数化、一致性、Bedrock原生集成、审计）不足。
explanations.D: 问题：服务不匹配：SageMaker Canvas不是Bedrock的提示模板治理核心方案，且与'Amazon Bedrock to implement governance process'偏离。版本控制方式错误：CloudFormation用于基础设施即代码部署，并不适合作为'prompt templates版本控制与审批流'的主要方案。AWS Config用于资源配置合规审计，不是审批工作流引擎，也不是prompt活动审计的主要方式。缺少对提示模板参数化一致性、跨团队复用治理的明确支持。结论：整体不符合题意。

question: A company is developing a customer support application that uses Amazon Bedrock foundation models (FMs) to provide real- time AI assistance to the company's employees. The application must display AI-generated responses character by character as the responses are generated. The application needs to support thousands of concurrent users with minimal latency. The responses typically take 15 to 45 seconds to finish. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API with an AWS Lambda integration. Configure the WebSocket API to invoke the Amazon Bedrock InvokeModelWithResponseStream API and stream partial responses through WebSocket connections.
options.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API with an AWS Lambda integration. Configure the REST API to invoke the Amazon Bedrock standard InvokeModel API and implement frontend client-side polling every 100 ms for complete response chunks.
options.C: Implement direct frontend client connections to Amazon Bedrock by using IAM user credentials and the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API without any intermediate gateway or proxy layer.
options.D: Configure an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with an AWS Lambda integration. Configure the HTTP API to cache complete responses in an Amazon DynamoDB table and serve the responses through multiple paginated GET requests to frontend clients.

explanations.A: 正确点：WebSocket天生适合服务端持续推送；Bedrock的InvokeModelWithResponseStream支持增量输出；能实现'字符/分片到达即展示'。并发与时长匹配：15–45秒的生成时长可由Lambda处理（在Lambda最大执行时长15分钟内）。并发扩展由API Gateway + Lambda承担，适合数千并发（注意配额/并发控制与连接管理）。实现细节提醒：实际工程中通常先建立WebSocket接口口，使用API Gateway Management API对连接进行postToConnection推送分片；题干推描述'配置WebSocket API去调用Bedrock并流式传输'是对该模式的概括。结论：满足'逐字显示、低延迟、高并发、长响应'的综合要求。
explanations.B: 错误点1（不满足逐字实时）：InvokeModel是标准非流式调用，通常需等模型生成完成后才返回（或至少不保证token流式到达前端）。错误点2（高并发下放大负载）：每100ms轮询意味着每个用户每秒10次请求；数千用户会产生巨量QPS，API Gateway/Lambda成本和延迟都会恶化。错误点3（体验与延迟）：轮询天然引入抖动与额外延迟，无法做到真正'边生成边展示'。结论：不满足要求。
explanations.C: 错误点1（安全合规）：在前端分发IAM user长期凭证正是反模式，存在泄露风险，几乎不可接受。错误点2（权限控制与审计）：缺少中间层难以做精细化授权、速率限制、内容过滤、审计与统一治理。补充：即便'技术上可行'的方向，也应使用临时凭证（如Cognito身份池+IAM Role）而非IAM user credentials；题目明确写IAM user credentials，因此判错更明确。结论：不满足企业级要求（尤其安全），不应选。
explanations.D: 错误点1（不满足实时逐字）：该方案是'先生成完整结果存入DynamoDB，再分页拉取'，本质不是边生成边展示。错误点2（延迟）：用户必须等待写入DynamoDB后才能读到内容，额外增加端到端延迟。错误点3（复杂度与成本）：为流式场景引入缓存与分页读取不必要；并发下DynamoDB读写会被放大。结论：不满足要求。

question: A company is using Amazon Bedrock to design an application to help researchers apply for grants. The application is based on an Amazon Nova Pro foundation model (FM). The application contains four required inputs and must provide responses in a consistent text format. The company wants to receive a notification in Amazon Bedrock if a response contains bullying language. However, the company does not want to block all flagged responses. The company creates an Amazon Bedrock flow that takes an input prompt and sends it to the Amazon Nova Pro FM. The Amazon Nova Pro FM provides a response. Which additional steps must the company take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management to specify the required inputs as variables. Select an Amazon Nova Pro FM. Specify the output format for the response. Add the prompt to the prompts node of the flow.
options.B: Create an Amazon Bedrock guardrail that applies the hate content filter. Set the filter response to block. Add the guardrail to the prompts node of the flow.
options.C: Create an Amazon Bedrock prompt router. Specify an Amazon Nova Pro FM. Add the required inputs as variables to the input node of the flow. Add the prompt router to the prompts node. Add the output format to the output node.
options.D: Create an Amazon Bedrock guardrail that applies the insults content filter. Set the filter response to detect. Add the guardrail to the prompts node of the flow.
options.E: Create an Amazon Bedrock application inference profile that specifies an Amazon Nova Pro FM. Specify the output format for the response in the description. Include a tag for each of the input variables. Add the profile to the prompts node of the flow.

explanations.A: 正确：'使用Prompt Management将必需输入指定为变量'可以把4个输入以变量形式约束在prompt模板中，满足'required inputs'的实现方式。'指定输出格式'是保证响应一致文本格式的常见做法（在模板中要求固定结构/字段）。'添加到flow的prompts节点'符合在Flow中使用托管Prompt的方式。
explanations.B: 错误：题目要检测的是'bullying language'，更近似insults/harassment类过滤，而不是'hate'。更关键：此选项将filter response设为block，与'公司不想阻止所有flagged responses'直接冲突。
explanations.C: 错误：Prompt router的用途通常是根据输入特征在多个prompts/models之间路由，并不是实现'4个必填输入+统一输出格式+侮辱检测通知'的必要组件。它没有解决'在Bedrock中对bullying/insults做检测并通知但不阻断'的Guardrail需求。把输出格式放在output node并不是Bedrock里保证一致格式的主要机制；一致格式通常通过prompt指令/模板约束完成。
explanations.D: 正确：'insults content filter'与题目'bullying language（霸凌/侮辱性语言）'最匹配。将响应设置为detect：可以让系统对内容进行标记/输出检测结果/用于告警或审计，但不会阻断响应，符合'不会block all flagged responses'。添加到flow的prompts节点，符合在生成调用链路上施加guardrail的方式。
explanations.E: 错误：Inference profile的核心是推理调用配置/模型选择与相关运行配置，并不是用来'在description里指定输出格式'或'用tag表示输入变量'的标准做法。它也没有满足'bullying language检测并通知但不阻断'的guardrail需求。因此无法同时满足两大关键要求（格式一致性与侮辱检测通知）。

question: A healthcare company is using Amazon Bedrock to build a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application that helps practitioners make clinical decisions. The application must achieve high accuracy for patient information retrievals, identify hallucinations in generated content, and reduce human review costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Comprehend to analyze and classify RAG responses and to extract medical entities and relationships. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate automated evaluations. Configure Amazon CloudWatch metrics to track entity recognition confidence scores. Configure CloudWatch to send an alert when accuracy falls below specified thresholds.
options.B: Implement automated large language model (LLM)-based evaluations that use a specialized model that is fine-tuned for medical content to assess all responses. Deploy AWS Lambda functions to parallelize evaluations. Publish results to Amazon CloudWatch metrics that track relevance and factual accuracy.
options.C: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics to generate test queries that have known answers on a regular schedule, and track model success rates. Set up dashboards that compare synthetic test results against expected outcomes.
options.D: Deploy a hybrid evaluation system that uses an automated LLM-as-a-judge evaluation to initially screen responses and targeted human reviews for edge cases. Use Amazon SageMaker Feature Store to maintain evaluation datasets. Use a built-in Amazon Bedrock evaluation to track retrieval precision and hallucination rates.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Amazon Comprehend's entity extraction only reflects NLP confidence and cannot measure retrieval accuracy or detect hallucinations in generated content, so it does not meet the requirements for hallucination detection and reduced human review.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Fine-tuning and running a specialized model to evaluate every response is costly and lacks the automated-screening-plus-targeted-human-review loop and the built-in retrieval-precision and hallucination tracking needed to reduce human review costs.
explanations.C: Incorrect. CloudWatch Synthetics is for endpoint availability (canary) testing and cannot systematically evaluate RAG retrieval accuracy or identify hallucinations in generated content.
explanations.D: 正确点：混合评估体系：先用自动化LLM-as-a-judge初筛，再对边缘案例做定向人工复核，直接对应'降低人工审核成本'。明确提到跟踪retrieval precision与hallucination rates：这与题目'高准确检索+识别幻觉'强匹配。使用Bedrock内置evaluation的表述，符合'在Bedrock上构建RAG并做评估'的考试语境：用原生评估/指标体系更贴题。可能的眼症/争议点：'SageMaker Feature Store维护evaluation datasets'并非最常见选择：评估集通常会用S3/Glue/Athena或专用数据管理；Feature Store更偏特征管理。但这不影响该选项核心：有评估数据集管理+自动评估+人审兜底+指标跟踪。结论：最完整覆盖三项要求，是四个选项中最契合的一项。

question: Company configures a landing zone in AWS Control Tower. The company handles sensitive data that must remain within the European Union. The company must use only the eu-central-1 Region. The company uses SCPs to enforce data residency policies. GenAI developers at the company are assigned IAM roles that have full permissions for Amazon Bedrock. The company must ensure that GenAI developers can use the Amazon Nova Pro model through Amazon Bedrock only by using cross-Region inference (CRI) and only in eu-central-1. The company enables model access for the GenAI developer IAM roles in Amazon Bedrock. However, when a GenAI developer attempts to invoke the model through the Amazon Bedrock Chat/Text playground, the GenAI developer receives the following error. User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AssumedDevRole/DevUserName Action: bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream On resource(s): arn:aws:bedrock:eu-west-3::foundation-model/amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 Context: a service control policy explicitly denies the action The company needs a solution to resolve the error. The solution must retain the company's existing governance controls and must provide precise access control. The solution must comply with the company's existing data residency policies. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add an AdministratorAccess policy to the GenAI developer IAM role.
options.B: Extend the existing SCPs to enable CRI for the eu.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 inference profile.
options.C: Enable Amazon Bedrock model access for Amazon Nova Pro in the eu-west-3 Region.
options.D: Validate that the GenAI developer IAM roles have permissions to invoke Amazon Nova Pro through the eu.amazon.nova- pro.v1:0 inference profile on all European Union AWS Regions that can serve the model.
options.E: Extend the existing SCP to enable CRI for the eu.* inference profile.

explanations.A: A. 向 GenAI 开发人员 IAM 角色添加 AdministratorAccess 策略。 错误。原因 : SCP 的 Explicit Deny 优先于任何 IAM Allow，即使是 AdministratorAccess 也无法绕过。 不满足"保留现有治理控制和和“精确访问控制"的要求 (权限过大) 。
explanations.B: B. 扩展现有的 SCP 以为eu.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 推理配置文件启用 CRI。正确。原因：报错明确为 SCP 显式拒绝，必须在 SCP 层修复，否则任何 IAM 变更无效。 按'特定 inference profile (eu.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0) “放行，符合“精确访问控制“。 可保持现有"仅 EU、仅特定入口区域"的治理策略，同时允许 Bedrock 以 CRI 方式在 EU 内部跨区承载。
explanations.C: C. 在 eu-west-3 区域为Amazon Nova Pro 启用 Amazon Bedrock 模型访问。 错误。原因 : 题目要求"开发者只能通过 CRI 且仅在 eu-central-1 使用"。在 eu-west-3 直接启用模型访问，会增加“可在 eu-west-3 直接调用"的可 能性，不够符合治理目标。 当前失败的根因是 SCP Deny，即使启用模型访问，仍可能继续被 SCP 拒绝。
explanations.D: D. 验证 GenAI 开发人员 IAM 角色是否具有在所有可提供该模型的欧盟 AWS 区域中，通过 eu.amazon.nova-pro.v1:0 推理配置文 件调用 Amazon Nova Pro 的权限。 正确。原因: 虽然入口区域要求是 eu-central-1，但 CRI 的实际承载区域可能是 eu-west-3 等欧盟区域。 从报错看，权限评估落在了 eu-west-3 的 foundation-model ARN 上; 因此需要确保 IAM 权限链路覆盖 CRI 可能涉及的欧盟承载区 域/资源。 配合 SCP 针对特定 inference profile 放行"，可以在不放开任意跨区的情况下，满足 CRI 的工作方式。
explanations.E: E. RA: 报错明确为 SCP 显式拒绝，必须在 SCP 层修复，否则任何 IAM 变更无效。 按'特定 inference profile (eu.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0) “放行，符合“精确访问控制“。 可保持现有"仅 EU、仅特定入口区域"的治理策略，同时允许 Bedrock 以 CRI 方式在 EU 内部跨区承载。

question: A financial services company is developing a customer service AI assistant by using Amazon Bedrock. The AI assistant must not discuss investment advice with users. The AI assistant must block harmful content, mask personally identifiable information (PIl), and maintain audit trails for compliance reporting. The AI assistant must apply content filtering to both user inputs and model responses based on content sensitivity. The company requires an Amazon Bedrock guardrail configuration that will effectively enforce policies with minimal false positives. The solution must provide multiple handling strategies for multiple types of sensitive content. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a single guardrail and set content filters to high for all categories. Set up denied topics for investment advice and include sample phrases to block. Set up sensitive information filters that apply the block action for all PII entities. Apply the guardrail to all model inference calls.
options.B: Configure multiple guardrails by using tiered policies. Create one guardrail and set content filters to high. Configure the guardrail to block PII for public interactions. Configure a second guardrail and set content filters to medium. Configure the second guardrail to mask PIl for internal use. Configure multiple topic-specific guardrails to block investment advice and set up contextual grounding checks.
options.C: Configure a guardrail and set content filters to medium for harmful content. Set up denied topics for investment advice and include clear definitions and sample phrases to block. Configure sensitive information filters to mask PII in responses and to block financial information in inputs. Enable both input and output evaluations that use custom blocked messages for audits.
options.D: Create a separate guardrail for each use case. Create one guardrail that applies a harmful content filter. Create a guardrail to apply topic filters for investment advice. Create a guardrail to apply sensitive information filters to block PII. Use AWS Step Functions to chain the guardrails together sequentially. Use conditional logic based on content classification.

explanations.A: 优点：单一guardrail覆盖所有推理调用；设置拒绝主题来阻止投资建议；对PII实体配置敏感信息过滤。问题1：误杀风险高：把所有类别的内容过滤都设为high，通常会显著增加false positives，不符合'minimal false positives'。问题2：PII处理策略不满足'多种处理策略'：对所有PII都用block，但题干明确要求'mask PII'（脱敏），并且还要求'multiple handling strategies for multiple types of sensitive content'。问题3：输入/输出双向过滤没有明确：虽然'应用于所有模型推理调用'通常会让guardrail评估输入与输出，但A并未明确强调双向评估与差异化处理（例如只有mask输出）。结论：不满足'最小误杀+PII需要mask+多策略'的综合要求。
explanations.B: 优点：试图用'分层策略'满足不同场景（公网交互block PII、内部use mask PII），并通过topic guardrails阻止投资建议。问题1：一次推理调用通常只能附加一个guardrail：该选项假设'配置多个guardrails并按场景叠加/组合'，这在Bedrock Guardrails的常见使用方式中并不直接成立（通常是每次调用选择一个guardrail）。问题2：与题目要求不匹配：题目并未要求区分'公网vs内部'两套策略，而是要求同一个AI assistant在交互中做到：不谈投资建议、拦截有害内容、mask PII、审计、输入输出都过滤。问题3：引入'contextual grounding checks'不贴题：投资建议限制主要靠topic/政策约束，不是典型的grounding校验用例；增加复杂度且不直接解决核心需求。结论：架构假设与题目目标偏离，且多个guardrail组合并非最直接可行的guardrail配置方案。
explanations.C: 优点1：降低误杀：将harmful content过滤设为medium，通常比high更能平衡安全与可用性，更符合'minimal false positives'。优点2：投资建议用denied topics精准拦截：提供清晰定义与示例短语，有助于减少误判/漏判，满足'must not discuss investment advice'。优点3：多类型敏感内容的多策略处理：对PII在响应中mask（符合题干'mask personally identifiable information'）；对某些敏感/金融信息在输入中block（体现'multiple handling strategies for multiple types of sensitive content'）。优点4：输入与输出双向评估：明确启用input和output evaluations，满足'apply content filtering to both user inputs and model responses'。关于审计：选项提到'custom blocked messages for audits'表述不够严谨（审计通常依赖Bedrock调用日志/CloudTrail/日志落地），但在'guardrail配置层面'它至少体现了：有明确的拦截动作与可识别的阻断响应，并且双向评估更利于记录合规事件。结论：整体最贴合全部要求，并且符合'低误杀+多策略+输入输出双向过滤'。
explanations.D: 优点：把不同策略拆分，理论上更模块化；用编排（Step Functions）做串联与条件逻辑。问题1：过度工程化且不属于'guardrail configuration'本身：题目要的是'Amazon Bedrock guardrail configuration'，而该选项引入Step Functions编排属于额外系统设计，不是最直接的guardrail配置解法。问题2：多guardrail串联的可行性/必要性存疑：Bedrock并不原生支持在一次模型响应中按顺序跑多个guardrail；用Step Functions可能导致多次调用模型/多次评估，成本、延迟、实现复杂度都上升。问题3：难以保证'最低误杀'：串联多个策略更容易出现累计误杀效应；同时条件逻辑需要可靠的分类信号与一致的审计策略。结论：不是满足题旨的最优与最贴合的方案。

question: An ecommerce company is developing a generative AI (GenAI) solution that uses Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic Claude to recommend products to customers. Customers report that some of the recommended products are not available for sale on the website or are not relevant to the customer. Customers also report that the solutions takes a long time to generate some recommendations. The company investigates the issues and finds that most interactions between customers and the product recommendation solution are unique. The company confirms that the solutions recommends products that are not in the company's product catalog. The company must resolve these issues. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Increase grounding within Amazon Bedrock Guardrails. Enable Automated Reasoning checks. Set up provisioned throughput.
options.B: Use prompt engineering to restrict the model responses to relevant products. Use streaming techniques such as the InvokeModelWithResponseStream action to reduce perceived latency for the customers.
options.C: Create an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. Implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). Set the PerformanceConfigLatency parameter to optimized.
options.D: Store product catalog data in Amazon OpenSearch Service. Validate the model's product recommendations against the product catalog. Use Amazon DynamoDB to implement response caching.

explanations.A: A. Increase grounding within Amazon Bedrock Guardrails... Enable Automated Reasoning... provisioned throughput 为什么 可能有用: Provisioned throughput 可能降低排队/抖动，改善延迟。 Guardrails 的"grounding/事实依据"相关能力在某些场景可用于减少无依据输出。 为什么不足/不正确: 题干问题的根因是模型没有被强制基于“商品目录"这一权威数据源生成。仅靠 Guardrails 的"增加 grounding "并不能等价于'“接入并 检索商品目录来生成"。 Automated Reasoning 更偏向策略/逻辑一致性等检查 (并不能自动让模型只输出目录内商品) 。 即便延迟改善，也不能系统性解决“推荐目录外商品/不相关"的主要矛盾。 结论: 不满足"必须解决推荐目录外商品“的核心要求，整体不选。
explanations.B: B. Prompt engineering... + streaming (InvokeModelWithResponseStream) 为什么可能有用 : Streaming 可以降低感知延迟 〈先返回部分 token) 。 提示词工程可在一定程度上约束输出格式与范围。 为什么不足/不正确: 仅靠提示词无法可靠阻止模型"编造"目录外商品; 这属于提示词不具备强约束/可验证数据注入的典型问题。 Streaming 只解决“看起来更快，但不一定减少真实推理时间; 且与“目录外推荐"无直接治理关系。 结论: 不能从根本上解决真实性与相关性问题，不选。
explanations.C: C. Create an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. Implement RAG. Set PerformanceConfigLatency to optimized. 为什么正 确: 用 Bedrock Knowledge Bases + RAG: 将公司商品目录作为可检索知识源，让模型在生成推荐时基于检索到的目录内容，从机制 上减少"目录外商品”的幻觉。 RAG 还能提升相关性: 通过对客户意图/偏好进行检索匹配，返回更贴近的目录商品信息。 PerformanceConfigLatency = optimized: 以低延迟为目标的性能配置，有助于改善生成耗时长的问题 (在不改变业务逻辑的情 况下做推理侧优化) 。 可能的注意点 (但不影响本题结论) : 仍需确保知识库数据同步、检索质量 (chunk、embedding、过滤条件、元数据约束等) 设置合理。 结论: 同时履盖“真实性/相关性 + 延迟优化"，最符合题意，选。
explanations.D: D. Store product catalog in OpenSearch... Validate recommendations... DynamoDB response caching 为什么可能有用: OpenSearch 可做检索;“校验推荐是否在目录中"可过滤掉明显错误项。 缓存在高重复问答场景可显著降延迟。 为什么不足/不正确: 题干指出大多数交互是唯一的，使用 DynamoDB 做响应缓存命中率会很低，性价比差，难以解决"长时间生成"的主要痛点。 "Validate recommendations“是事后过滤/校验: 它可能把目录外商品剔除，但不能保证模型生成的剩余内容就相关，也可能导致结 该方案没有明确“用检索结果来引导生成”(即 RAG 编排) ，而只是”验证*，对减少幻觉的系统性不如 RAG。 结论: 部分缓解但不如 RAG 直接且缓存不契合"交互唯一"，不选。

question: A company is using AWS Lambda and REST APIs to build a reasoning agent to automate support workflows. The system must preserve memory across interactions, share the relevant agent state, and support event-driven invocation and synchronous invocation. The system must also enforce access control and session-based permissions. Which combination of steps provides the MOST scalable solution? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to manage memory and session-aware reasoning. Deploy the agent with built-in identity support, event handling, and observability.
options.B: Register the Lambda functions and the REST APIs as actions by using Amazon API Gateway and Amazon EventBridge. Enable Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to invoke the Lambda functions and the REST APIs without custom orchestration code.
options.C: Use Amazon Bedrock Agents for reasoning and conversation management. Use AWS Step Functions and Amazon SQS queues for orchestration. Store the agent state in Amazon DynamoDB to maintain memory between steps.
options.D: Deploy the reasoning logic as a container on Amazon ECS behind Amazon API Gateway. Use Amazon Aurora to store memory data and identity data.
options.E: Build a custom RAG pipeline by using Amazon Kendra and Amazon Bedrock. Use AWS Lambda to orchestrate tool invocations. Store the agent state in Amazon S3. Amazon S3 中。

explanations.A: 正确：AgentCore直接覆盖题目关键点：memory、session-aware reasoning、identity support（用于访问控制/会话权限）、以及对事件处理与可观测性的内建支持。相比自建（DynamoDB/S3/Aurora）状态管理与权限校验，托管的会话/身份能力更符合MOST scalable与低运维。
explanations.B: 正确：题目明确需要：event-driven invocation与synchronous invocation。用API Gateway对接REST API（天然支持同步请求/响应），用EventBridge做事件驱动（异步触发/事件路由），并让AgentCore在无需自定义编排代码的情况下调用这些actions，满足可扩展与解耦。该选项强调'注册actions + AgentCore直接调用'，减少glue code与编排瓶颈，更贴近'最可扩展'。
explanations.C: 错误（不最优/不满足MOST scalable的核心方向）：Bedrock Agents + Step Functions + DynamoDB当然可行，但这是偏自建编排与自管状态的模式。题目强调会话权限与共享agent state，C需要你自己设计：state schema、并发一致性、会话权限校验、跨服务鉴权与授权传播。在'同等满足需求'的前提下，相比AgentCore的托管会话/身份/记忆能力，C的运维与实现复杂度更高，因此不属于MOST scalable的最佳组合。
explanations.D: 错误：ECS + Aurora属于更传统的自建服务形态，需要自己实现：推理编排、工具调用、会话管理、权限系统与状态同步。Aurora用于memory/state与identity数据并非不可以，但对'高并发会话状态/短期读写'与'事件驱动+同步双模式'而言，会引入更多自建复杂度与扩展/连接管理问题。与Bedrock AgentCore/原生actions集成相比，D明显不够'托管化'，不满足MOST scalable的偏好。
explanations.E: 错误：自建RAG + Lambda编排工具调用，会带来较多自定义编排逻辑。将agent state存在S3通常不适合作为会话级、频繁读写、需要低延迟与并发一致性控制的状态存储；实现session-based permissions与状态共享也会更复杂。Kendra解决检索，不直接解决题干核心的'会话记忆/状态共享/权限与调用模式'全套需求。

question: A financial services company is developing a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application to help investment analysts query complex financial relationships across multiple investment vehicles, market sectors, and regulatory environments. The dataset contains highly interconnected entities that have multi-hop relationships. The analysts must be able to examine the relationships holistically to provide accurate investment guidance. The application must deliver comprehensive answers that capture indirect relationships between financial entities. The application must produce responses in less than 3 seconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with Graph RAG and Amazon Neptune Analytics to store the financial data. Analyze the multi-hop relationships between entities and automatically identify related information across documents.
options.B: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and an Amazon OpenSearch Service vector store to implement custom relationship identification logic that uses AWS Lambda functions to query multiple vector embeddings in sequence.
options.C: Use an Amazon OpenSearch Serverless vector database with k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) searches. Implement manual relationship mapping in an application layer that runs in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Use Amazon DynamoDB to store financial data in a custom indexing system. Use an AWS Lambda function to query relevant records based on input questions. Use Amazon SageMaker AI to generate responses.

explanations.A: A. Bedrock Knowledge Bases + Graph RAG + Neptune Analytics 为什么正确: Graph RAG 专门用于多跳关系与跨实体关联的增强检索: 能把"间接关系“系统性纳入上下文，而不是靠向量相似度碰运气。 Neptune (此处为 Neptune Analytics) 提供面向图的存储/分析能力，适合复杂金融实体网络 (投资工具、行业、监管环境) 的图 遍历/路径分析。 Bedrock Knowledge Bases 提供托管式编排，减少自建检索管道、索引管理、编排逻辑的运维成本，符合LEAST operational overhead, 多跳关系在图引擎中通常能更直接高效地计算，减少“串行多次检索 + 应用层拼接“带来的延迟，更易满足<3 秒。 潜在注意点: 需要确保数据建模为图 (节点/边) 并与知识库/Graph RAG 流程集成; 但相比自建仍是较低运维。
explanations.B: B. Bedrock Knowledge Bases + OpenSearch 向量库 + Lambda 串行多次查询实现自定义关系识别 为什么不优/偏错误 : 向量库的 kNN 检索本质是“相似度召回“，对多跳关系与间接关系覆盖并不天然擅长。 通过 Lambda “IMF SiS Male KRUSE: 属于自定义编排逻辑，运维与复杂度更高 (函数编排、重试、超时、状态管 理、链路追踪) 。 串行多次查询容易造成延迟累积，不利于稳定满足<3 秒。 题干要求"整体审视关系"，更像图遍历/图推理，而不是多次向量召回拼接。 结论: 能做但运维不最少、上且多跳关系效果不如图方案。
explanations.C: C. OpenSearch Serverless 向量库 kNN + EC2 Auto Scaling 应用层手动关系映射 为什么错误 : 把“关系映射?放到应用层并跑在 EC2 ASG: 需要自建服务、扩缩容策略、发布、监控、故障处理，显著增加运维开销。 手动关系映射对“高度互联、多跳关系“会迅速变得复杂且难维护。 仍主要依赖向量检索，不是最适合多跳关系的检索范式。 结论: 与"least operational overhead'“明显相悖。
explanations.D: D. DynamoDB 自定义索引 + Lambda 查询 + SageMaker 生成 为什么错误 : DynamoDB 适合键值/宽表访问与明确访问模式，但题干是多跳关系网络，需要类似图遍历的查询能力; 在 DynamoDB 上做多跳关 系通常意味着大量自定义索引与访问模式设计，开发/维护成本高。 “自定义索引系统"本身就意味着较高运维与持续迭代成本，不符合最少运维开销。 SageMaker 当然可以生成，但关键瓶颈在关系检索与多跳推理，并非只换个推理端就能解决。 Sit: 不匹配图关系检索本质需求，且运维偏重。

question: A healthcare company uses Amazon Bedrock to deploy an application that generates summaries of clinical documents. The application experiences inconsistent response quality with occasional factual hallucinations. Monthly costs exceed the company's projections by 40%. A GenAI developer must implement a near real-time monitoring solution to detect hallucinations, identify abnormal token consumption, and provide early warnings of cost anomalies. The solution must require minimal custom development work and maintenance overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudWatch alarms to monitor InputTokenCount and OutputTokenCount metrics to detect anomalies. Store model invocation logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Glue and Amazon Athena to identify potential hallucinations.
options.B: Run Amazon Bedrock evaluation jobs that use LLM-based judgments to detect hallucinations. Configure Amazon CloudWatch to track token usage. Create an AWS Lambda function to process CloudWatch metrics. Configure the Lambda function to send usage pattern notifications.
options.C: Configure Amazon Bedrock to store model invocation logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable text output logging. Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to run contextual grounding checks to detect hallucinations. Create Amazon CloudWatch anomaly detection alarms for token usage metrics.
options.D: Use AWS CloudTrail to log all Amazon Bedrock API calls. Create a custom dashboard in Amazon QuickSight to visualize token usage patterns. Use Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor to detect quality drift in generated summaries.

explanations.A: 优点：CloudWatch告警监控InputTokenCount/OutputTokenCount能覆盖token使用异常的一部分。问题1（幻觉检测不近实时）：把日志落到S3后用Glue + Athena去'识别潜在幻觉'，通常是离线/准离线分析，需要建表、ETL、查询逻辑，可能还要引入判定模型或规则，难做到近实时。问题2（开发与维护开销大）：Glue作业、Athena表/分区/查询、数据质量、成本与权限治理都带来持续运维负担，不符合'minimal custom development work and maintenance overhead'。结论：不满足'近实时+低开发运维'的综合要求，整体不如原生Guardrails + CloudWatch Anomaly Detection。
explanations.B: 优点：Bedrock evaluation jobs（基于LLM判定）可用于质量评估，理论上能识别幻觉倾向；CloudWatch跟踪token使用也合理。问题1（评估作业通常非实时在线检测）：Evaluation jobs更多用于离线评测/抽样评估/基准测试，不是为在线近实时'每次请求做幻觉检测而设计，难以满足'near real-time monitoring'。问题2（自定义开发增加）：引入Lambda处理CloudWatch指标并发通知属于自定义逻辑；而CloudWatch本身就可用告警/异常检测直接通知SNS等，Lambda属于额外维护点。结论：可行但不够'最小开发与维护'；评估作业也不如Guardrails更贴近在线防护与检测。
explanations.C: 优点1（原生日志审计）：Bedrock将模型调用日志写入S3，并启用文本输出日志，满足医疗场景对审计与追踪的需要，也便于后续抽检与合规分析。优点2（幻觉检测/降低：Guardrails grounding checks）：通过Bedrock Guardrails的contextual grounding checks对输出进行基于上下文/来源的事实一致性查，可用于识别'无依据生成/事实偏离'等幻觉风险，符合'detect hallucinations'的目标，并且是托管能力，开发运维低。优点3（近实时token异常与成本预警）：为token指标创建CloudWatch异常检测告警可以在使用模式偏离基线时快速告警（比静态阈值更适合'异常'场景），满足'identify abnormal token consumption'和'early warnings of cost anomalies'。注意点：grounding checks的有效性依赖你是否能提供'依据/上下文来源'（例如检索到的临床文档片段、知识库检索结果等）来做对齐；但在'临床文档总结'应用中通常具备可用的输入上下文，因此是合理方案。结论：最符合'近实时+最小开发+低维护'三重要求。
explanations.D: 问题1（CloudTrail不等于质量与token监控）：CloudTrail记录API调用审计事件，不提供token级别用量异常检测的最佳路径（token指标在CloudWatch更直接）。问题2（QuickSight仪表板不是近实时告警）：可视化有用，但对'near real-time monitoring'与'early warnings'而言，告警机制更关键；且自建数据集与刷新也带来维护。问题3（SageMaker Model Monitor不匹配Bedrock文本生成监控）：Model Monitor主要面向部署在SageMaker上的模型与数据漂移/质量监控；对Bedrock托管LLM的幻觉检测并非最直接方案，集成成本也更高。结论：服务选型不贴合Bedrock场景与题目约束。

question: A company is building a generative AI (GenAI) application that produces content based on a variety of internal and external data sources. The company wants to ensure that the generated output is fully traceable. The application must support data source registration and enable metadata tagging to attribute content to its original source. The application must also maintain audit logs of data access and usage throughout the pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Lake Formation to catalog data sources and control access. Apply metadata tags directly in Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor API activity.
options.B: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to register and tag data sources. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to monitor access patterns and application behavior.
options.C: Store data in Amazon S3 and use object tagging for attribution. Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to manage schema information. Use AWS CloudTrail to log access to S3 buckets.
options.D: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to register all data sources. Apply metadata tags to attribute data sources. Use AWS CloudTrail to log access and activity across services.

explanations.A: A. Lake Formation 编目与访问控制 + S3 直接打元数据标签 + CloudTrail 优点: Lake Formation/CloudTrail 都是与数据治理/审计强相关的服务; CloudTrail 能记录 API 调用用于审计。 问题 1 (标签位置不理想) : 题目强调"支持数据源注册并启用元数据 tagging 来归因到原始 source“。如果把标签"直接打在 S3 对 象上“，更像是对象级标签管理; 但公司数据来源是“多种内部与外部数据源"“，不一定都在 S3 对象层面能一致实现归因标签。 问题 2 (中心化注册与归因表达不清) : Lake Formation 本质上依赖 Glue Data Catalog 做表/库等元数据编目与权限; 但选项描述 把“归因标签"放到 S3 ，而不是放到目录层 (表/数据源实体) ，不利于统一的数据源级归因与检索。 结论: 可以做部分治理与审计，但在"统一数据源注册 + 统一归因标签模型“上不如目录化方案直接与清晰，因此不选。
explanations.B: B. Glue Data Catalog 注册与标记 + CloudWatch Logs 监控访问模式 优点: Glue Data Catalog 非常适合做数据源注册与元数据标签 (表/库/列级元数据与标签策略等) 。 关键问题 (审计不满足) : CloudWatch Logs 主要用于收集应用与服务日志、做告警与可观测性; 它不等同于“对数据访问与使用的 审计日志“。 审计更需要CloudTrailie录 API 调用 (谁、何时、对哪些资源做了什么) ，以满足可追责性与合规要求。 结论: 审计要求不满足，排除。
explanations.C: C. S3 存储 + 对象标签归因 + Glue Catalog 管 shema + CloudTrail 只记录 S3 访问 优点: S3 对象标签可用于对象级归因; CloudTrail 可记录对 S3 的访问 (如 data events 配置后可记录对象级 API) 。 问题 1 (审计范围不足) : 题目要求"在整个 pipeline 维护审计日志 (data access and usage throughout the pipeline) “。此选项仅 提到记录对 S3 buckets 的访问，无法覆盖跨服务 (例如 Glue、Athena、Bedrock、Lambda、Opensearch 等) 对数据的访问与使用 行为。 间题 2 (注册与归因模型偏对象级) : 主要把归因放在 S3 对象标签上，面对“多来源 (internal/external) “与"内容生成引用"场景， 目录层的统一数据源注册与标签更匹配。 结论: 审计范围与归因方式不够全面，排除。
explanations.D: D. Glue Data Catalog 注册所有数据源 + 元数据标签归因 + CloudTrail 记录跨服务访问与活动 满足数据源注册: Glue Data Catalog 可以集中登记数据资产 (数据库/表/元数据) ，涵盖多种数据源与抽象层。 满足元数据标签归因: 在目录层对数据源/表等进行标签管理，有利于统一实现"生成内容可追溯到原始 source’ WIT ARE (至少在 元数据层面可查、可解释) 。 满足全链路审计: CloudTrail 能记录跨 AWS 服务的 API 调用与活动，适合作为"audit logs of data access and usage throughout the pipeline"“的基础审计能力。 Sit: 三项要求覆盖最完整、 表述最贴合题意，因此选择 D。

question: A financial services company needs to build a document analysis system that uses Amazon Bedrock to process quarterly reports. The system must analyze financial data, perform sentiment analysis, and validate compliance across batches of reports. Each batch contains 5 reports. Each report requires multiple foundation model (FM) calls. The solution must finish the analysis within 10 seconds for each batch. Current sequential processing takes 45 seconds for each batch. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency to process each analysis type sequentially. Configure the Lambda function timeouts to 10 seconds. Configure automatic retries with exponential backoff.
options.B: Use AWS Step Functions with a Parallel state to invoke separate AWS Lambda functions for each analysis type simultaneously. Configure Amazon Bedrock client timeouts. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to track execution time and model inference latency.
options.C: Create an Amazon SQS queue to buffer analysis requests. Deploy multiple AWS Lambda functions with reserved concurrency. Configure each Lambda function to process different aspects of each report sequentially and then combine the results.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon ECS cluster that runs containers that process each report sequentially. Use a load balancer to distribute batch workloads. Configure an auto-scaling policy based on CPU utilization to handle demand fluctuations.

explanations.A: 为什么不正确：题干核心是'顺序处理45秒'，A仍然是'按顺序处理每种分析类型'，本质不解决并行化问题。10秒超时：把超时设置成10秒并不能让任务更快，只会让超时失败率更高。自动重试：重试会进一步拉长端到端时间，更不利于10秒SLA。
explanations.B: 为什么正确：把'财务数据分析/情感分析/合规验证'等彼此独立的分析类型并行执行，可显著降低总时延（总时延接近最长分支耗时，而非各分支之和）。适配多次FM调用：每个Lambda分支内部可以按需要进行多次Bedrock调用（或在分支内进一步并行）。超时与可观测性：配置Bedrock客户端超时、用CloudWatch监控执行时间/推理延迟，有助于确保满足10秒目标并快速定位慢点。潜在不足但不影响其为最佳选项：题干是'每批5份报告'，更理想是Step Functions再配合Map并发处理每份报告；不过在给定选项中，B是唯一明确引入并行编排以压缩关键路径时延的方案。
explanations.C: 为什么不正确：SQS更偏向削峰填谷与异步解耦，不是面对'单批10秒内必须完成'的强时延SLA。顺序处理问题仍在：描述里'按顺序处理每份报告的不同方面然后合并结果'，关键链路仍可能接近串行时延。额外排队时延：队列可能引入不可控排队等待，反而不利于严格的10秒完成要求（除非系统非空闲且精细控制，但选项未体现）。
explanations.D: 为什么不正确：仍然强调'每份报告顺序处理'，无法从根本上把45秒串行压缩到10秒。扩缩指标不匹配：Bedrock调用通常是网络/外部推理延迟主导，CPU利用率不一定能有效反映瓶颈；即使扩容也不一定降低单批端到端时延。实现复杂且不直击并行编排：题目核心是并行化工作流，ECS并非最直接选择。

question: A company is using Amazon Bedrock to build a customer-facing AI assistant to handle sensitive customer inquiries. The company must use defense-in-depth safety controls to block sophisticated prompt injection attacks. The company must keep audit logs of all safety interventions. The AI assistant must have cross-Region failover capabilities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to use content filters to protect against prompt injection attacks. Set the content filters to high. Use a guardrail profile to implement cross-Region guardrail inference. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs with custom metrics to capture detailed guardrail intervention events.
options.B: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to use content filters to protect against prompt injection attacks. Set the content filters to high. Use AWS WAF to block suspicious inputs. Use AWS CloudTrail to log API calls for audits.
options.C: Deploy Amazon Comprehend custom classification to detect prompt injection attacks. Use Amazon API Gateway to validate requests. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs with custom metrics to capture detailed intervention events.
options.D: Configure Amazon Bedrock guardrails to use custom content filters to protect against harmful content. Set the content filters to high. Use word filters to protect against known attack patterns. Configure cross-Region guardrail replication to provide failover capabilities. Store logs in AWS CloudTrail for compliance auditing.

explanations.A: 优点（满足点）：提到使用 guardrail profile 实现 cross-Region guardrail inference：这是四个选项中对"跨区域故障转移/跨区域推理"描述最到位的。使用 CloudWatch Logs + 自定义指标 捕获详细干预事件：更可能满足"记录所有安全干预审计日志"的要求（比只记录API调用更详细）。缺点/风险（不严谨点）：把"prompt injection 防护"说成"content filters（内容过滤器）"实现：概念上不严谨。内容过滤通常用于有害内容类别（仇恨/暴力/色情/自残等），而提示注入越狡更应依赖 Guardrails 的专门对抗能力与策略组合（例如对抗提示攻击检测、话题限制、系统提示保护等）。"纵深防御"若严格解释为多层（如 WAF/网关验证/速率限制 + Guardrails），A 没有显式第二层入口防护（但题干并未强制必须WAF，只强调 defense-in-depth；Guardrails 内部多策略叠加也可被视作纵深的一部分）。结论：尽管表述中把 prompt injection 归因到 content filters 不够准确，但在跨区域故障转移与干预审计日志细节两个硬性条件上，A 是最符合的一项。
explanations.B: 优点：增加 AWS WAF：可作为入口层的补充防护（如阻断明显恶意模式、Bot、速率限制等），符合"纵深防御"的思路。CloudTrail：适合做合规审计的"API 调用记录"。致命缺陷：没有跨区域故障转移方案：题目要求 AI assistant 必须具备 cross-Region failover capabilities，但 B 完全未涉及（这通常是硬性否决项）。CloudTrail 记录的是API调用，不是所有安全干预细节：题目要求"keep audit logs of all safety interventions"，需要能审计"Guardrails 如何介入/拦截/改写/拒答"的事件级信息；只用 CloudTrail 往往不够。同样把 prompt injection 防护归因于 content filters，概念不严谨。结论：不满足跨区域故障转移与"干预事件细粒度审计"要求，因此整体不满足题意。
explanations.C: 优点：用 API Gateway 做请求校验，可作为入口层防护的一部分。用 CloudWatch Logs 记录干预事件，方向上更贴近"干预审计"。问题：没有跨区域故障转移设计。用 Comprehend 自定义分类来检测 prompt injection：可行但工程复杂、训练与维护成本高，而且与"使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建助手"场景下原生 Guardrails 的定位不匹配；并且"复杂提示注入"对分类器泛化能力要求极高，风险大。题目强调"使用 defense-in-depth safety controls"，通常期望以 Bedrock Guardrails 为核心安全控制之一；C 完全绕开 Guardrails。结论：不满足跨区域故障转移，且方案偏离 Bedrock 原生安全能力，整体不符合。
explanations.D: 优点：提到 content filters、word filters：在"多策略叠加"方向上比只写 content filters 更接近纵深防御。关键问题："cross-Region guardrail replication"：这个表述不标准/不可信。更常见的是通过 profile/跨区域推理方式实现，而不是"复制"。CloudTrail 作为安全干预日志存储：CloudTrail 仍主要是 API 调用审计，不是"所有安全干预细节事件"的最佳承载。对 prompt injection 的防护仍停留在"词表匹配已知模式"，对"sophisticated prompt injection attacks"往往不够。结论：跨区域能力表述可疑，审计方式也不匹配"干预事件"要求，整体不如 A。

question: A company is designing a canary deployment strategy for a payment processing API. The system must support automated gradual traffic shifting between multiple Amazon Bedrock models based on real-time inference metrics, historical traffic patterns, and service health. The solution must be able to gradually increase traffic to new model versions. The system must increase traffic if metrics remain healthy and decrease traffic if the performance degrades below acceptable thresholds. The company needs to comprehensively monitor inference latency and error rates during the deployment phase. The company must also be able to halt deployments and revert to a previous model version without any manual intervention. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Bedrock with provisioned throughput to host the versions of the model. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Step Functions workflow when a new model version is released. Configure the workflow to shift traffic in stages, wait for a specified time period, and invoke an AWS Lambda function to check Amazon CloudWatch performance metrics. Configure the workflow to increase traffic if the metrics meet thresholds and to trigger a traffic rollback if performance metrics fall below thresholds.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda functions to invoke various Amazon Bedrock model versions. Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with stage variables and weighted routing to shift traffic gradually to new model versions. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use external logic to adjust traffic between model versions and to roll back if performance falls below thresholds.
options.C: Use Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint variants to represent multiple Amazon Bedrock model versions. Use variant weights to shift traffic. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor performance metrics. Use SageMaker Model Monitor to trigger AWS Lambda functions to roll back a model deployment if performance drops below a specified threshold. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to roll back model deployments if an anomaly is detected.
options.D: Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to track inference logs. Configure OpenSearch Service to invoke an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to update Amazon Bedrock model endpoints to shift traffic based on the inference logs.

explanations.A: 优点/符合点：EventBridge 触发 Step Functions：满足"新模型版本发布后自动开始部署流程"的事件驱动自动化。Step Functions 分阶段切流 + 等待窗口：满足"渐进式增加流量"的 canary 过程控制。Lambda 检查 CloudWatch 指标：满足"全面监控推理延迟与错误率"，并能基于实时指标做决策。工作流内置条件分支：指标健康则继续放量，指标恶化则自动回滚，满足"无需人工干预的停止/回退"。方案容易扩展：除实时指标外，也可在 Lambda 中读取历史流量模式（例如 CloudWatch 指标历史、日志分析结果、DynamoDB/Forecast 结果等）作为决策输入，从而贴合题干"historical traffic patterns"。潜在注意点（不影响作为最佳答案）：Bedrock本身并不像 SageMaker Endpoint Variant 那样原生支持权重切流。实际落地通常需要一个"路由层/配置"（例如通过调用方读取权重配置来选择不同 modelId），但选项A的 Step Functions"shift traffic in stages"的表述与这类落地方式是匹配的（通过更新路由配置实现阶段性切流）。结论：满足自动化渐进放量、指标驱动决策、自动回滚与监控要求，是最贴合题干的端到端闭环方案。
explanations.B: 不符合点：API Gateway HTTP API 并不以"stage variables + weighted routing"作为标准的灰度能力描述；即便要做权重路由，通常需要在别处（例如 Lambda 别名权重、CloudFront、或自定义路由逻辑）。选项明确写了"Use external logic to adjust traffic ... and to roll back"：这意味着关键能力依赖外部自建逻辑，难以保证"全面自动化、无人工干预"的循环（至少不是AWS原生编排循环）。题干强调"必须能够 halt deployments 并 revert 无需任何人工干预"，B 的"external logic"描述过于笼统，缺少明确的自动化编排与回滚机制设计。结论：可作为部分组件思路，但作为"满足全部要求的最佳方案"不够完整，也不够AWS原生闭环。
explanations.C: 关键错误："Use SageMaker endpoint variants to represent multiple Amazon Bedrock model versions"在概念上不成立：Bedrock 托管模型并非以"SageMaker Endpoint Variant"方式部署与切流；SageMaker Endpoint Variant 是SageMaker托管推理的能力，不是Bedrock模型版本管理/切流机制。其他不匹配：SageMaker Model Monitor 主要面向SageMaker推理端点的数据漂移/质量监控等；题干关注推理延迟/错误率与发布灰度，这类指标通常直接来自 CloudWatch（及应用层/调用层指标）。结论：基础前提不成立，因此不正确。
explanations.D: 不符合点：仅用 OpenSearch 跟踪日志 + SSM Automation 更新端点，无法直接满足"基于实时指标的分阶段放量、自动回滚、自动停止部署"的完整闭环。OpenSearch 更偏日志分析与检索，并非发布编排与灰度控制的核心服务；SSM Automation 也能自动化，但选项缺少对"阶段性权重切换、等待窗口、基于 CloudWatch 延迟/错误率阈值决策"的明确设计。结论：方案不完整，且不够贴合题目对灰度发布编排与指标驱动自动回滚的要求。

question: A financial services company uses an AI application to process financial documents by using Amazon Bedrock. During business hours, the application handles approximately 10,000 requests each hour, which requires consistent throughput. The company uses the CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API to purchase provisioned throughput. Amazon CloudWatch metrics show that the provisioned capacity is unused while on-demand requests are being throttled. The company finds the following code in the application: python response = bedrock_runtime.invoke_model(modelId="anthropic.claude-v2", body=json.dumps(payload)) The company needs the application to use the provisioned throughput and to resolve the throttling issues. Which solution will meet these requirements? bedrock_runtime.invoke_model(modelId="anthropic.claude-v2", body=json.dumps(payload))

options.A: Increase the number of model units (MUs) in the provisioned throughput configuration.
options.B: Replace the model ID parameter with the ARN of the provisioned model that the CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API returns.
options.C: Add exponential backoff retry logic to handle throttling exceptions during peak hours.
options.D: Modify the application to use the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API instead of the InvokeModel API.

explanations.A: A. Increase the number of model units (MUs) in the provisioned throughput configuration. 错误。 RA: 当前问题不是“预 置吞吐量不够"，而是预置吞吐量根本没被用到 (指标显示 unused) 。增加 MU 只会花更多钱，且请求仍可能继续走按需通道并被 限流。
explanations.B: B. Replace the model ID parameter with the ARN of the provisioned model that the CreateProvisionedModelThroughput API returns. 正确。 原因: 要让调用使用 Provisioned Throughput，应用在调用 InvokeModel 时需要指定预置吞吐量资源的ARN (由 CreateProvisionedModelThroughput 返回/关联) 。这样 Bedrock 才会将请求路由到已购买的预置容量，从而避免按需限流并 利用已付费的吞吐量。
explanations.C: C. Add exponential backoff retry logic to handle throttling exceptions during peak hours. 错误 (不满足题目核心要求) 。 原因: 重试只能“缓解"部分限流带来的失败，但不会让请求使用预置吞吐量，也不会解决"预置容量闲置"的根因; 在高并发下重试 还可能加剧排队和延迟。
explanations.D: D. Modify the application to use the InvokeModelWithResponseStream API instead of the InvokeModel API. 错误。 JRA: 是否使用 streaming API 与是否命中 provisioned throughput 并无直接必然关系。即便用流式返回，如果仍然使用基础模型ID，也 可能仍走按需通道并被 throttled。该选项没有解决“路由到预置容量"的关键点。

question: A company is building an AI advisory application by using Amazon Bedrock. The application will provide recommendations to customers. The company needs the application to explain its reasoning process and cite specific sources for data. The application must retrieve information from company data sources and show step-by-step reasoning for recommendations. The application must also link data claims to source documents and maintain response latency under 3 seconds. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with source attribution enabled. Use the Anthropic Claude Messages API with RAG to set high-relevance thresholds for source documents. Store reasoning and citations in Amazon S3 for auditing purposes.
options.B: Use Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic Claude models and extended thinking. Configure a 4,000-token thinking budget. Store reasoning traces and citations in Amazon DynamoDB for auditing purposes.
options.C: Configure Amazon SageMaker AI with a custom Anthropic Claude model. Use the model's reasoning parameter and AWS Lambda to process responses. Add source citations from a separate Amazon RDS database.
options.D: Use Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic Claude models and chain-of-thought reasoning. Configure custom retrieval tracking with the Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases API. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor response latency metrics.

explanations.A: A. 使用启用了源归因的 Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases + Claude Messages API + RAG闭值控制 + S3存审计 正确点 (满足需求) : 检索公司数据源: Knowledge Bases原生对接企业数据源并完成向量化与检索编排 (RAG) 。 引用具体来源: 开启source attribution后，可把生成内容与被检索到的片段/文档关联，输出引用信息，满足"ink data claims to source documents”, 低运维开销: 托管RAG (索引、检索、权限集成等) 比自建检索链路更省运维。 延迟控制: 通过设置高相关性阈值/控制返回片段数量，有助于降低"无关文档过多导致token膨胀"的延迟风险，从而更易达成<3 BD. 可能的瑕疵/注意点: “将推理过程存S3审计'“并非题干硬性要求〈题干没说必须落库审计) ，但不影响核心方案成立，只是多了可选的记录链路。 “step-by-step reasoning'“应以解释性步骤呈现，而不是暴露模型内部chain-of-thought原文; 仍可通过提示词要求输出"步骤化解释 +每步引用"。 Sit: 整体最贴合需求且运维最少，属于最佳候选。
explanations.B: B. Bedrock + Claude extended thinking (4000 tokens thinking budget) + DynamoDB人存推理与引 用 错误点 (不满足关键需求) : 缺少企业数据检索链路: 没有Knowledge Bases / RAG / 数据源检索方案，无法保证“必须从公司数据源检索信息“。 缺少可验证引用生成机制: 仅靠"thinking"不能自动产生与公司文档绑定的引用; 引用需要检索与source attribution或自建证据链。 延迟风险: 4,000 token的thinking预算通常会显著增加推理时间与输出处理开销，与<3秒目标冲突。 结论: 不满足RAG+引用的核心要求，且延迟更难达标。
explanations.C: C. SageMaker AI BEX Claude + reasoning 参数 + Lambda处理 + RDS提供引用 错误点 〈运维开销过大且架构不贴合) : 高运维: 在SageMaker上自定义/托管大模型 (尤其是Claude这类闭源模型) 在现实与考试语境中都不符合"最小运维开销"的方向; 并且Bedrock本身已托管模型与集成能力。 引用拼接不可靠: 从RDS“单独添加来源引用”往往是后处理拼装，难以保证每条主张与检索证据一一对应 (除非再实现复杂的检索 与对齐逻辑) 。 延迟链路更长: 模型调用 + Lambda后处理 + RDS查询，端到端时延与故障点增多，不利于<3秒。 is: 明显不符合"最小运维"上且实现复杂。
explanations.D: D. 可能的瑕疵/注意点: “将推理过程存S3审计'“并非题干硬性要求〈题干没说必须落库审计) ，但不影响核心方案成立，只是多了可选的记录链路。 “step-by-step reasoning'“应以解释性步骤呈现，而不是暴露模型内部chain-of-thought原文; 仍可通过提示词要求输出"步骤化解释 +每步引用"。 Sit: 整体最贴合需求且运维最少，属于最佳候选。

question: A financial services company uses multiple foundation models (FMs) through Amazon Bedrock for its generative AI (GenAI) applications. To comply with a new regulation for GenAI use with sensitive financial data, the company needs a token management solution. The token management solution must proactively alert when applications approach model-specific token limits. The solution must also process more than 5,000 requests each minute and maintain token usage metrics to allocate costs across business units. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Develop model-specific tokenizers in an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to estimate token usage before sending requests to Amazon Bedrock. Configure the Lambda function to publish metrics to Amazon CloudWatch and trigger alarms when requests approach thresholds. Store detailed token usage in Amazon DynamoDB to report costs.
options.B: Implement Amazon Bedrock Guardrails with token quota policies. Capture metrics on rejected requests. Configure Amazon EventBridge rules to trigger notifications based on Amazon Bedrock Guardrails metrics. Use Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize token usage trends across models.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon SQS dead-letter queue for failed requests. Configure an AWS Lambda function to analyze token-related failures. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to generate reports on token usage patterns based on error logs from Amazon Bedrock API responses.
options.D: Use Amazon API Gateway to create a proxy for all Amazon Bedrock API calls. Configure request throttling based on custom usage plans with predefined token quotas. Configure API Gateway to reject requests that will exceed token limits.

explanations.A: A. 在 Lambda 中开发模型特定 tokenizer; 调用前估算 token; CloudWatch 指标+告警; DynamoDB 存明细 正确点: 主动性满足: 在请求发往 Bedrock 前估算 token，可在"接近模型上限"时告警或采取动作 (例如拒绝、降级、截断、改用大窗口模 型等) 。 模型特定满足: 可针对不同 FM 使用不同 tokenizer/规则，符合“model-specific token limits”, 高吞吐可扩展: Lambda 水平扩展可支撑 5,.000+/分钟〈需注意并发配额与冷启动，但总体是可扩展路径) 。 成本分挫满足: CloudWatch 可做趋势/告警; DynamoDB 可按 BU、模型、应用、时间维度记录明细 token 用量，用于内部计费 (showback/chargeback) 。 潜在代价/注意点 (不影响其成为最佳答案) : 实现与维护 tokenizer 成本高; 不同模型的 token 规则可能变化，需要版本管理。 仅“估算"可能与最终计费 token 有偏差; 但题目强调"接近限制与“主动告警"'，估算是合理手段。 Sit: 满足题目所有硬性要求，方案完整。
explanations.B: B. 使用 Bedrock Guardrails + token quota policies; 基于 Guardrails 指标触发通知; CloudWatch dashboard 展示 错误点: Bedrock Guardrails 的主要能力是内容安全与策略控制 (如有害内容、主题限制、PII 等) ，并非面向"token 配额/模型 token 上限 管理“的原生机制。 即便能拿到“被拒绝请求"的指标，也更偏事后 (rejected 后才知道) ，不符合"接近上限就主动告警"的精确诉求。 该选项没有提供按 BU 维度沉淀明细 token 用量的存储设计，成本分推不完整。 结论: 不满足核心的"token 管理/配额/接近上限预警 + 成本分推明细"要求。
explanations.C: C. SQS 死信队列 + Lambda 分析 token 相关失败 + Logs Insights 基于错误日志做报告 错误点: RED: 依赖'失败请求/错误日志'再分析，是典型的事后处理，无法在"接近限制前“预警。 覆盖面不足: 只有失败/进入 DLQ 的才会被分析，无法形成完整 token 使用计量。 成本分摊不可靠: 用错误日志推导 token 使用趋势，既不完整也不精确，且难以按 BU 做稳健记账。 结论: 不满足"主动告警"和"完整 token 指标/明细“要求。
explanations.D: D. API Gateway 代理所有 Bedrock 调用; 用 usage plan 做 token 配额; 超限则拒绝 错误点: API Gateway usage plan/限流主要基于请求速率/配额 (request count) ，不是基于“token 数"这种需要解析并分词计算的单位。 API Gateway 本身无法在不实现自定义计算逻辑的情况下判断请求会消耗多少 token，更无法做到“model-specific token limits“的精 确判断。 题干要求"接近上限主动告警 + 维护 token 用量指标用于成本分挫*，该方案只谈拒绝与节流，缺少 token 计量与明细沉淀设计。  结论: 不满足 token 维度的管理与计量要求。

question: A retail company is developing a customer service application that must process 10,000 daily queries about products, orders, and warranties. The application must be able to respond to queries about 50,000 product documents that are updated every day. The application must integrate with an order management API to check the status of orders and to help process returns. The application must maintain context throughout multi-turn interactions with customers. The company must collect complete audit trails for application responses. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Deploy a fine-tuned Amazon Bedrock Anthropic Claude model for each product category. Create AWS Lambda functions to connect each model to the order management API. Store conversation history in Amazon DynamoDB.
options.B: Create a custom model that uses continued pre-training on Amazon Bedrock to handle all product documentation. Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API that uses AWS Lambda functions to connect the model to the order management API.
options.C: Use Amazon SageMaker AI with containers to deploy models. Use Amazon Kendra to search product documents. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate calls to the order management API.
options.D: Use an Amazon Bedrock agent with action groups to integrate with the order management API. Associate an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base with the agent to search product documentation by using Retrieval Augmentation Generation (RAG). Enable trace events to capture audit trails.

explanations.A: 优点：Lambda 连接订单API可行；DynamoDB 存对话历史也可实现多轮。问题1：按产品类别分别微调并部署多个模型：产品文档每日更新，微调模型很难每天跟上变化；多模型生命周期管理（训练、版本、评估、回滚、成本）带来高运维开销。问题2：知识获取方式不合理：题目强调 50,000 文档且每日更新，更适合 RAG/知识库索引；微调并不擅长频繁文档更新和可追溯引用。问题3：审计链路：需要自行拼装日志（提示词、检索、工具调用、最终输出），相比 Bedrock trace 更费事。结论：能做但运维开销显著，不满足"LEAST operational overhead"。
explanations.B: 优点：API Gateway + Lambda 集成订单API可行。问题1：continued pre-training（持续预训练）运维成本极高：需要准备训练数据管道、训练作业、评估、安全与回滚；对每日更新文档而言，持续预训练不是低成本更新机制。问题2：知识与事实更新：持续预训练不保证对最新订单/退货政策等事实的一致，且很难做可解释的引用与审计。问题3：多轮上下文与审计：需要自己做会话管理与全链路审计收集（请求、上下文拼接、工具调用等）。结论：运维开销最大之一，不符合最小运维。
explanations.C: 优点：Kendra 可用于企业搜索，适合大量文档；Step Functions 可编排对订单API调用；SageMaker 可部署模型。问题1：组件过多导致运维增加：SageMaker 容器化部署（扩缩容、镜像、补丁、监控）、Kendra 索引维护、Step Functions 工作流管理，整体运维明显高于 Bedrock 托管Agent方案。问题2：多轮上下文：需要自建对话状态存储与提示词编排逻辑（并不天然包含在该组合里）。问题3：审计：仍需自行串联检索结果、模型输入输出、工作流执行记录形成"完整审计轨迹"。结论：可满足功能，但不是最小运维。
explanations.D: 满足 API 集成：Bedrock Agent 的 action groups 可将订单管理API封装为工具，让模型在需要时自动调用（查订单状态、退货处理）。满足海量且每日更新文档：通过 Bedrock Knowledge Base + RAG 检索产品文档，文档更新通过更新数据源/同步索引实现，比微调/持续预训练运维低。满足多轮上下文：Agent 面向对话场景设计，原生支持多轮交互编排（相比自建 DynamoDB + 手工拼接提示更省事）。满足审计：启用 trace events 可捕获推理过程、检索、工具调用与响应链路，用于完整审计轨迹与排障。运维最小：核心能力由 Bedrock 托管（Agent、RAG、工具调用、Trace），无需自建模型托管/工作流编排/检索系统。结论：在满足全部需求前提下，最符合"LEAST operational overhead"。

question: An ecommerce company is using Amazon Bedrock to build a generative AI (GenAI) application. The application uses AWS Step Functions to orchestrate a multi-agent workflow to produce detailed product descriptions. The workflow consists of three sequential states: a description generator, a technical specifications validator, and a brand voice consistency checker. Each state produces intermediate reasoning traces and outputs that are passed to the next state. The application uses an Amazon S3 bucket for process storage and to store outputs. During testing, the company discovers that outputs between Step Functions states frequently exceed the 256 KB quota and cause workflow failures. A GenAI Developer needs to revise the application architecture to efficiently handle the Step Functions 256 KB quota and maintain workflow observability. The revised architecture must preserve the existing multi-agent reasoning and acting (ReAct) pattern. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store intermediate outputs in Amazon DynamoDB. Pass only references between states. Create a Map state that retrieves the complete data from DynamoDB when required for each agent's processing step.
options.B: Configure an Amazon Bedrock integration to use the S3 bucket URI in the input parameter for large outputs. Use the ResultPath field and the ResultSelector field to route S3 references between the agent steps while maintaining the sequential validation workflow.
